title: 3.0 - PDOException is thrown when paginating with hasMany or belongsToMany relationships in empty pages.

milestone.description:
New major release that breaks compatibility with 2.x

- PHP5.4.19+
- New ORM & behaviors.
- Improved Routing
- PSR-0 and composer support.
- Simpler configuration and bootstrapping.
- Improved configuration handling.
- Improved bake.

See [the roadmap](http://github.com/cakephp/cakephp/wiki/3.0-roadmap) for more details.

body:
When paginating a model with `hasMany`or `belongsToMany` relationships, a `PDOException` is thrown when trying to see a non existent page.

If the primary model is not related or has other type of relationships the classic 404 exception is thrown.
